run.sequence: the first L tokens of the text
run.perturbation: any point within delta in sup-norm of the layer's realised normalised input

attack: per (layer, length): rank targets by random sign probes at the smallest delta; exact gradient rows of the best-ranked targets; per delta, sign-gradient ascent on the largest change over all positions from the two best rows' signs and from a random corner, and on the largest change at the last position from its best row; step size from 2 delta down to delta / 8; every best point rescored with released.mixer_trace in float64
